$comment: Completion bar for #116: fixYoutubeEmbedHeaders registered an onBeforeSendHeaders listener that never called Electron's callback, so every */embed/* request hung and the player stayed black. Fix: the listener moves to electron/youtube-embed-headers.ts (rewriteYoutubeEmbedHeaders) and calls callback({ requestHeaders }) exactly once on every path. Criterion 1 is behavioral and fails before the change: test:media-ingest invokes the listener for a file:// referrer, an empty referrer, a dev (localhost) referrer and an unparseable URL, and asserts one callback per call with rewritten headers only in the file:// cases. 2-4 guard typecheck, build and the IPC suite (whose mock now passes a callback). Live check on a production build over CDP: the embed loads and plays (see PR).
